name: QTT Tenant Product Subscription Pointer
description: The real, database-enforced 'at most one active subscription per (tenant, product)' guarantee — hardening review section 9. MariaDB has no partial/filtered unique index, and historical QTT Product Subscription rows must be allowed to coexist for audit purposes, so the constraint lives here instead, on a table that only ever holds the CURRENT pointer. All writes go through qtt_platform.subscription.service.activate_pointer(); no role holds write/create/delete DocPerm.
